description: Use to remove what pd6694_ssi_run left; it is also its undo. For Route A cases use pd6694_route_a_remove. Removes everything an SSI run left (design pressure cases, spring groups, analysis cases) and restores the model's own springs from the run's backup (the plugin's Remove SSI). Previews unless apply: true.
name: pd6694_ssi_remove
title: Remove PD 6694 SSI results
